plans.buy_case: IP is flashing textbook mean-reversion signals: RSI 39.9 is oversold, price is pinned to the lower Bollinger Band, and MACD is bottoming with upside inflection. The 50/200MA golden cross and price holding at the 200MA support provide a technical floor, making this a clean swing entry point for a reversion trade over 2-4 weeks.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 30-32 (not yet there) OR price to touch lower BB again with volume confirmation. Do NOT chase at 37.24—patience rewards you here. If RSI stays 38-42 for 2+ days without breaking lower, that's your signal that reversal is confirmed.
plans.exit_condition: Sell 50% at RSI 60-65 or first touch of 50MA ($39.19). Trail stop on remaining 50% to 38.80. Hard exit if price breaks 200MA support (37.50) on heavy volume—this kills the thesis.
plans.timeframe: 2-4 weeks (aggressive) / up to 8 weeks (patient hold to upper BB)
plans.risk: IP lacks recent news catalysts—this is a purely technical trade. Macro cyclical headwinds (recession fears, paper demand weakness) could break support despite technicals. VIX at 14.5 is dangerously complacent; any vol spike could flush this before reversal plays out. Fundamental neutral rating is a red flag; do NOT add on dips.

plans.buy_case: MMM is flashing textbook mean-reversion signals: RSI 35.5 (oversold), price kissing lower Bollinger Band, and MACD inflection point—all with price safely above 200MA. A Bollinger Band squeeze into oversold territory historically precedes sharp reversals. However, the incomplete news picture is a material blind spot for a quality company in a neutral fundamental state.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to touch 30 or lower, OR price to print at/below lower BB (≈$165.40). Do NOT chase at current $168.56—you want confirmation of the reversal, not capitulation entry. If MMM bounces before hitting 30 RSI, enter on a pullback into the 32-34 RSI zone.
plans.exit_condition: Sell half at RSI 60 (mean reversion target), stop-loss at $162 (break below lower BB + 200MA support). Exit remaining position if RSI breaks above 70 without follow-through volume, or if MMM closes below 200MA on high volume (structural break). Set alert for any negative earnings surprises or guidance cuts.
plans.risk: Incomplete news data is a red flag—MMM could have pending litigation, earnings misses, or guidance cuts that justify lower prices. VIX 14.5 also signals complacency; a macro shock could gap this lower overnight. Position size (1 share on $3,846 portfolio) mitigates downside but limits upside. Industrials cyclical exposure adds macro sensitivity.

plans.buy_case: LYV is showing classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 39 (near oversold), price hugging lower Bollinger Band with active squeeze, and strong 200MA structure (golden cross intact). Low VIX environment suggests complacency, but the technical confluence—especially BB squeeze + RSI in buy zone—historically precedes sharp reversals in quality names.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 30-32 range OR price to touch lower BB (≈$170.80). Do NOT chase at current $173.50. Also verify no negative earnings/guidance news before entry—the data gap is a real risk.
plans.exit_condition: Sell half at RSI 70+ OR price hits $185 (upper BB ~$187); stop-loss hard at $167 (below 200MA support). Exit immediately if LYV reports weak guidance or major tour cancellations.
plans.risk: Entertainment/live events sector is discretionary and economically sensitive. Earnings surprise downside, macro slowdown spooking consumer spending, or a guidance miss could trigger violent reversals. Also: you're buying into low-volatility complacency (VIX 14.5)—that's when whipsaws hurt most. Single-share position limits your upside but rightfully respects your $3.8K portfolio.

plans.buy_case: ITW is showing textbook mean-reversion setup: RSI 35.7 (oversold), price at lower Bollinger Band (0.11 pct), and MACD inflection—all firing together on above-average volume. Price is anchored above the 200MA with a golden cross intact, providing a quality risk/reward for a 4-8 week swing. However, the neutral fundamental backdrop and thin recent news require you to validate earnings quality and FCF trends before committing.
plans.entry_condition: Enter on first touch of lower Bollinger Band (~$268) or if RSI dips to 25-28 on intraday weakness. Confirm volume support (>1.0x 20-day avg) on entry bar. Do NOT chase if price bounces back to $273+—wait for a fresh pullback.
plans.exit_condition: Sell into strength on RSI >65 (overbought) OR if price breaks below 200MA ($264.72) on heavy volume (indicates momentum failed). Also trim/exit if BB upper band is tagged and MACD shows histogram rollover. Given low VIX complacency, raise sensitivity to unexpected negative news—exit immediately on earnings miss or guidance cut.
plans.timeframe: 4-8 weeks (peak swing window before mid-term consolidation risk)
plans.risk: Fundamental deterioration masked by technical setup; low VIX environment can reverse fast on risk-off. Single share limits cushion—a hard stop at $264 (200MA) means ~$6 max loss, but capital efficiency is poor if ITW sideways-trades for weeks. Industrials sensitive to macro slowdown signals.

plans.buy_case: SPG is flashing classic mean-reversion setup: RSI 32 (oversold), price kissing lower Bollinger Band with active squeeze, and MACD histogram turning up near valley. Price is anchored above 200MA with golden cross intact—the technical structure is clean. However, low VIX (14.5) signals complacency and reduced urgency; REITs are sensitive to rate expectations, and you need to verify recent earnings/dividend safety before pulling trigger.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip to 28–30 range OR price to touch lower BB (≈$207.50) with volume confirmation. Do not chase; this setup will repeat if missed.
plans.exit_condition: Sell into RSI >65 or price touches upper BB (~$233). Do NOT hold through earnings or rate announcements. If position breaks below 200MA ($199.38), exit half immediately—that breaks the filter.
plans.risk: REITs are rate-sensitive; any Fed hawkish surprise or rising yields will gap this down hard. Low VIX = complacency; volatility reversal could crush mean-reversion trades. Dividend safety is unclear without current financials—if cut, selloff is sharp. With only 1 share, position is too small to matter but adequate for learning.
